headline: This build introduces bag and icon scaling options in Appearance settings and delivers a pixel-perfect rendering overhaul across BetterBags Next.

entries.title: Icon and bag scaling in Appearance settings
entries.details: Added a Size tab to Appearance settings for BetterBags Next with Icon Scale and Bag Scale sliders (50% to 150%), allowing independent resizing of item buttons and floating bag panels while maintaining consistent row layouts.

entries.title: Pixel-perfect rendering across BetterBags Next
entries.details: All panels, tabs, text, interface controls, and item buttons now snap cleanly to whole screen pixels across all resolutions and UI scales, preventing missing one-pixel borders and visual artifacts while seamlessly supporting Masque skins.
